messages:
ana: quick heads up — hit a parity issue between ruby-sdk and js-sdk streaming payloads when running the sampleapp. parser fails on some streams.

sam_k: ugh, what shape is ruby emitting?

ana: ruby is wrapping events in an `event` object now after a refactor. example:```
{"event": {"type":"message","data":{"text":"hi"}}}
```
js/go send:```
{"type":"message","data":{"text":"hi"}}
```
sampleapp expects the latter and throws when it sees the wrapper.

louis: when did this land? which branch/PR?

ana: landed on main in PR 528 (small marshal change). bisected quickly — it's the streaming marshaller. seen failures in demo and E2E.

maya: why add wrapper? was it intended for metadata?

ana: yes, original intent was to add trace/session metadata later. but we didn't communicate the contract change.

sam_k: Plan: make sampleapp parsing tolerant, add ruby test asserting same envelope as js mock, and expose an opt-in client setting for new envelope shape. default must remain compatible for one release.

louis: agree. keep the fix minimal. we don't want to break downstream apps. add changelog note and a deprecation plan.

ana: implementing now: `parse_stream_event(payload)` that unwraps if `payload.key?('event')`. Also adding unit tests for both shapes.

ci-bot: build queued for branch `ana/stream-envelope-compat` (job #4823).

ana: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/539 — 3 files: parser tweak, tests, CHANGELOG. left comment about adding `stream_envelope: :legacy` option in next patch.

sam_k: nice and tiny. @louis can you review priority? we'll backport to 0.8.x if CI is green.

louis: reviewing now. if tests cover both shapes and no behavioral regressions, ship fast.

maya: please also add a short note in sampleapp README showing how to handle both envelopes. some users copy that parser.

ana: will add README blurb and open a backport PR after this merges. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
